<thought>Using the most intense ion at m/z 235.1395 as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral molecular mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 16 % of M) suggests about 13 carbons. A formula that matches the mass and isotopic pattern is C₁₃H₁₈N₂O₂, which fits the required “CxHyOzX” format as C13H18O2N2.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H18O2N2</final_answer>
